title.narrative: Program to Strengthen the Electricity Sector in Nicaragua
Programa para Fortalecer el Sector Elctrico en Nicaragua

description.narrative: El objetivo del Programa es generar condiciones dentro del sector elctrico de Nicaragua que lo siten en una senda de sostenibilidad financiera y ambiental y suficiencia energtica.
The program's objective is to create conditions within the electricity sector in Nicaragua which place it on a path of financial sustainability and environmental and energy sufficiency.
